channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Royal Ivey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Royal Ivey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Ron Naclerio on Kevin Durant, Royal Ivey
item.description:
Ivey was a Nets assistant when Durant was in Brooklyn; now he’ll face him with a chance to pull off a historic upset.

“KD and him are the best of friends. Royal is the tightest person [to Durant], maybe even tighter than his own biological brother. KD was in (Ivey’s) wedding party,”

Ron Naclerio on Kevin Durant, Royal Ivey, Jul 29, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jacque Vaughn on Royal Ivey, South Sudan
item.description:
“And even better news is our assistant coach Royal Ivey, South Sudan. Are you kidding me? Qualified. He put in the work, great team behind him,”

Jacque Vaughn on Royal Ivey, South Sudan, Feb 26, 2023. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Royal Ivey
item.description:
Royce Young:Durant on Royal Ivey being an assistant:

“I know everyone is saying I'm the reason he's on the staff, but he deserves it.”

Kevin Durant on Royal Ivey, Sep 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.
